snippet.title: Messy Village | Reveal Trailer | A Cozy Tidying Puzzle Game Coming to Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist Messy Village on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5391530/Messy_Village/ 

A village of party animals, a ghostly rumor, and one very tidy cat.

The village hall is said to be haunted, the parties have moved into every home, and the whole village has descended into chaos. Enter Tidy, a very organized cat with her own traveling cleaning company. Sort, match and clean your way through bite-sized tidying puzzles, meet the quirky locals and find out who, or what, is hiding in the village hall. Don't worry: it's much more shy than scary.

FEATURES
- Around 100 bite-sized tidying puzzles: sort, match, align, clean
- A colorful cast of villagers, each with their own brand of chaos
- A lighthearted story of about 5 to 6 hours
- No timers, no fail states, hints whenever you need them
- Colorful, hand-illustrated art
- Cute and family-friendly, fun for all ages

Platform: PC (Steam)
Release: 2027
Languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish

Developed by Mutation Studio: https://linktr.ee/mutationstudio
Published by Mutation Studio and Bubble Games: https://linktr.ee/Bubble_Games_

#MessyVillage #CozyGames #PuzzleGame #IndieGame #Steam
